parts.text: Submodule is now on the clean task branch `fix/contract-version-dialog-public-component`. Now I'll rewrite `contractDialog.vue` to wrap the public `zs-select-dialog` (`SelectDialog`), preserving the parent's `@set` / `:visible.sync` wiring via `$attrs`/`$listeners` passthrough (the same pattern the original used for `zs-dialog`). This also drops the hand-rolled table, pagination, and custom keyword search in favor of the standard built-in.

tool_input.content:
<template>
  <SelectDialog
    v-bind="$attrs"
    v-on="$listeners"
    title="选择合同版本"
    method="post"
    url="/presale/versionManagement/page"
    row-key="versionNo"
    :single-choice="true"
    @setData="handleSetData">
    <template slot="columns">
      <zs-table-column type="index" label="序号" width="60" />
      <zs-table-column label="合同版本编号" prop="versionNo" />
      <zs-table-column label="合同版本名称" prop="versionName" />
    </template>
  </SelectDialog>
</template>

<script>
import SelectDialog from '@/components/zs-select-dialog/zs-select-dialog-func.vue'
export default {
  name: 'ContractDialog',
  components: { SelectDialog },
  methods: {
    handleSetData(row) {
      // 透传选中行给父组件（保持原 @set 契约不变）
      this.$emit('set', row)
    }
  }
}
</script>
